title: Rongorongo script of Rapa Nui (Easter Island)
summary: Rongorongo is an undeciphered script engraved on fewer than 30 wooden objects from Rapa Nui. In 2024 radiocarbon dating of four tablets held in Rome found three from the nineteenth century and one whose wood dates to 1493-1509, suggesting the script predates European contact.

uncertainty.note: The script's date of invention is unknown. One tablet (D, the Echancree) has wood dated 1493 to 1509 cal AD (68.3%); the other three tablets dated fall in the nineteenth century. Radiocarbon dates the wood, not the carving (a caution in secondary coverage). The id year 1800 is not supported by an opened page.

as_recorded.value: the others fall within the nineteenth c. AD

when.display: tablet wood 1493–1509; other dated tablets 19th century

importance.justification: An undeciphered writing system that may be one of the few independently invented scripts.
